en: Plugin installations and updates now run in the background with progress notifications and cancellation. You can also choose GitHub, the official marketplace mirror, or a custom HTTPS mirror for plugin downloads. All paired devices must use v2.
zh: 插件安装和更新现在支持后台进行、进度通知和取消操作；你还可以为插件下载选择 GitHub、官方插件市场镜像或自定义 HTTPS 镜像。所有配对设备必须使用 v2。
